Color should change to dark pink, and solution will become transparent and viscous. Avoid incubating longer than 1 minute to prevent irreversible plasmid denaturation

steps_raw.title: Miniprep
steps_raw.instruction: Carefully transfer 800 µL supernatant to the spin column and centrifuge at 16000 x g, °C, 1 minute . Tilt the eppendorf tube away from the pellet and carefully pipette up the supernatant, ensuring the pipette tip does not touch the pellet or any debris stuck to the side of the tube.

steps_raw.title: Miniprep
steps_raw.instruction: Re-insert the column into the same collection tube and add 200 µL of Buffer BZ. Centrifuge for for 16000 x g, °C, 1 minute .

steps_raw.title: Miniprep

steps_raw.title: Miniprep
steps_raw.instruction: Transfer column to a clean, pre-labeled 1.5 mL eppendorf tube. Use care to ensure that the tip of the column does not come into contact with the flow-through in the collection tube.

steps_raw.title: Miniprep
steps_raw.instruction: With the snap-cap open, let ethanol evaporate for 00:02:00 from the column while sitting in the 1.5mL eppendorf tube.

steps_raw.title: Miniprep
steps_raw.instruction: Add 45 µL pre-heated to 50 °C . Elution Buffer or NFW to the center of the column's matrix. Incubate for 00:05:00 at 37 °C . Spin for 16000 x g, °C, 1 minute .

steps_raw.title: Miniprep
steps_raw.instruction: Transfer the flow-through now in the 1.5mL eppendorf tube back into the column's matrix to maximize yield. Incubate for 00:03:00 at 37 °C . Spin for 16000 x g, °C, 1 minute . Although this step may decrease final elute volume, it can increase yield.

steps_raw.instruction: In the clear round-bottom 96w plate, add 90 µL of appropriate media and 10 µL of each overnight culture (pipette to mix before transferring culture) in duplicate into the designated wells, to make 1:10 dilutions. steps_raw.title: Validation of Overnight Culture
steps_raw.instruction: Read OD600 using the BioTek Synergy H1 microplate reader. Copy the blanks and the OD values into the excel sheet downloaded in a previous step. The sheet will perform the following calculations to correct the sample measurements. OD corrected = (OD sample − average (OD blanks ) ) * 10
